method: Supervised binary classification: separate wrist CNN initialized from the parent wrist encoder and fine-tuned on a high-resolution fixed bottle crop, with episode/class-balanced BCE, AdamW and augmentation.
validation_operating_gate: Labeled tilt>=95 degrees and source outflow<3 nominal mL/s, an offline proxy for runtime proprioception/visual flow; all-angle errors reported. No test data.

roi_calibration.method: Fixed wrist ROI learned from training-only projected bottle envelopes; no live poses or validation/test ROI fitting.

training_augmentation.scope: Training crops only; validation and recordings remain native.
